rules.title: California residential security deposit limits and return rules
rules.requirement: Landlords may not demand or receive security over one month's rent (two months for qualifying small landlords with no more than two properties and four units, except for service members), in addition to first month's rent. Landlord must hold the deposit for the tenant, take photographs, and return the deposit with an itemized statement within 21 days after the tenant vacates.
rules.quoted_span: a landlord shall not demand or receive security, however denominated, in an amount or value in excess of an amount equal to one month’s rent, in addition to any rent for the first month paid on or before initial occupancy.
rules.key_value: 1 month's rent (2 months for qualifying small landlords)
rules.effective_date_note: Subdivision (c)(6) applies the cap to security collected on or after July 1, 2024 (AB 12). Current text amended by AB 414, effective 2026-01-01; photo requirements for tenancies beginning on or after 2025-07-01.
rules.exemptions: Small-landlord two-month cap applies only to natural persons or LLCs whose members are all natural persons who own no more than two residential rental properties with no more than four dwelling units total; not available for service member tenants. Advance payment of six months' rent allowed for leases of six months or longer.
rules.penalty: Bad faith retention may result in statutory damages up to twice the amount of the security, plus actual damages.

coverage.landlord_size_condition: Two-month cap only for natural person/LLC of natural persons owning no more than 2 properties with no more than 4 units total
unverifiable_exemptions: small landlord status for two-month cap

rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to security for a rental agreement for residential property used as the tenant's dwelling.

parsed.doc_summary: Official text of Cal. Civ. Code § 1950.5 as amended by AB 414 (eff. 1/1/2026). It caps residential security deposits at one month's rent (two months for qualifying small landlords, effective for security collected from 7/1/2024) and sets handling, inspection, photo and return rules. It yields one security-deposit record.
